app_identity.name: Amo Pay
app_identity.purpose: A comprehensive digital wallet and financial services platform designed for seamless money transfers, currency exchange, and merchant services.

steps: Select 'Send Money' from the dashboard or sidebar.
Enter the amount you wish to send in your local currency (e.g., PLN, USD).
View the real-time exchange rate and the amount the recipient will receive in RWF.
Lock the rate (valid for 300 seconds/5 minutes) to ensure no changes during processing.
Provide recipient details: Name, Source of Funds, and Rwanda Phone Number (+250 format).
Choose delivery method: Mobile Money or Bank Transfer.
Complete payment using Card, BLIK (Poland), Apple Pay, or Google Pay.
Generate and share the transaction receipt.

limits_and_fees.flat_fees: 5 PLN, 2 USD, 2 EUR, or 2 GBP depending on your account currency.

identity_verification_kyc.purpose: Required for higher transaction limits and enhanced security.
requirements: National ID or Passport (Front & Back photos)
Clear Selfie in a well-lit environment
identity_verification_kyc.process: Upload or take photos using the in-app camera. Review all documents before final submission.

merchant_services.how_to_register: Fill in Business Name, Business Phone, and optional physical address. You can also add your MoMo or Airtel codes.
merchant_services.benefits: Accept payments via QR code, manage sales through the Merchant Scanner, and view detailed merchant-specific analytics.
tools: Merchant QR: Personalized QR code for customers to scan.
Merchant Scanner: Integrated tool to process payments quickly.
Merchant Info: Manage your business profile.

user_guides.currency_exchange: Swap currencies instantly at competitive rates. The app provides daily rate updates and AI-powered guidance on the best times to exchange.
security_tips: Enable Face ID or Biometric Authentication for secure and fast login.
Never share your OTP or password with anyone.
Amo Pay uses SecureStore to protect your tokens and sensitive data.

support_and_help.help_center: Access detailed history, troubleshooting for KYC, and guide for all financial services.

troubleshooting.kyc_failure: Ensure photos are clear, well-lit, and all edges of the ID are visible.
troubleshooting.rate_expired: Rate locks last 5 minutes. If it expires, simply refresh to get the latest rate.
troubleshooting.payment_declined: Check with your bank for limits or try an alternative method like BLIK or Apple/Google Pay.

core_directories.components: Reusable UI elements and business components
core_directories.services: Business logic and API service layers
core_directories.utils: Helper functions for validation, security, and API communication

api_integration.refresh_logic: Silent sync and auto-refresh on authentication failure

account_states.unverified: User can browse but cannot send money. Must complete KYC first.
account_states.kyc_pending: Documents submitted, under review. Usually takes 24-48 hours.
account_states.kyc_verified: Full access to all features and higher transaction limits.
account_states.suspended: Account flagged. User must contact support at support@amopay.com

error_messages.insufficient_balance: Your wallet balance is too low. Please top up and try again.
error_messages.invalid_recipient: Recipient phone number not found. Check the number and try again.
error_messages.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
error_messages.rate_expired: Exchange rate expired after 5 minutes. Refresh to get latest rate.
error_messages.kyc_required: This action requires identity verification. Please complete KYC first.
error_messages.payment_declined: Payment declined by your bank. Try another payment method.
